description: Search the Creative Market catalog of fonts, graphics, templates, photos, 3D assets, illustrations, icons, mockups and stock video by keyword, style, mood or subject, e.g. 'retro display fonts for a vinyl record label'. Supports category, price range, staff-pick, on-sale, featured and recency filters, font width and weight filters, asset property filters such as vector, layered, web font and orientation, pagination, and sorting by best_match (relevance), popular, newest, trending, staff_pick, price_asc or price_desc. Each result includes the product title, starting price, thumbnail image, shop, category and product link, and the response carries a licensing note. Assets marked AI-generated are excluded.

categories.description: Filter by category IDs. Top-level: Graphics=1, Templates=2, Fonts=3, Add-ons=4, Photos=6, 3D=7, Stock Video=8, Illustrations=23, Icons=26, Mockups=1800. Font subcategories: Serif=80, Sans-Serif=81, Script=82, Handwritten=88, Blackletter=85.

include_images.description: Attach each product's thumbnail as an image block. Default true.

max_days_age.description: Only products published within this many days, 1-3650. The newest sort applies 15 when this is unset.

properties.description: Asset properties; multi-select is OR, any listed property matches: vector, raster, layered, tileable, web_font, layout_fluid, layout_fixed, layout_responsive, landscape, portrait, square, industry_film, industry_games, industry_design.

query.description: Natural language search query (e.g. 'hand-lettered script fonts for wedding invitations')

size.description: Number of results, 1-100. Default 12. Requests below 9 are raised to 9.

sort_by.description: How to sort results. Default: best_match

weight.description: Font weights: light, regular, bold, heavy. Multi-select is AND: a font family must offer every listed weight. Any value restricts results to fonts.

width.description: Font widths: condensed, normal, wide, monospaced. Multi-select is AND: a font family must offer every listed width. Any value restricts results to fonts.

name: search_products
title: Search Creative Market
